newsitem.title: HUNGARY: RESEARCH ALERT-CS First Boston keeps MOL as "hold".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CS First Boston keeps MOL as "hold".

text.p: CS First Boston said it maintained its 'hold' recommendation on shares in Hungarian oil and gas company MOL following its first half earnings released on Thursday.

"MOL reported H1 net income of 12.5 billion forints, in line with our expectations, but below the market's somewhat more optimistic consensus," said CSFB's analyst Spencer Jakab in a report dated August 14.

He said MOL's exploration and production business showed an improvement in profitability based on higher gas sales prices, with crude oil production declining in line with expectations. He added that MOL's downstream profitability also improved due to better refining margins.
Jakab said CSFB left its forecasts unchanged as first half figures were in line with expectations.
